The increase in selling general and administrative expenses is also concerning, as is the very high level of losses.

**Confidence Score:** The confidence score is moderate because of the contradictory signals. While sales are up, the profitability situation is significantly worse. Further investigation would be required to fully understand the underlying drivers of this situation (for example, a breakdown of what caused the spike in losses).
